 FOR SUBSCRIBERS 2026 Election James Talarico and Ken Paxton hold a day of dueling rallies as Texas begins early voting 
 Paxton, the Republican Senate candidate, brought out RFK Jr., while Democrat Talarico had the cast of “Friday Night Lights.” Listen to this article 00:00 00:00 The Texas Senate race between Republican Ken Paxton and Democrat James Talarico is one of the most closely watched in the country. AP; Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 20, 2026, 12:05 AM EDT By Natasha Korecki and Ryan Chandler FORT WORTH, Texas — Senate candidates Ken Paxton and James Talarico closed out a day of campaigning in this battleground area Monday, homing in on economic messages as Texans wrapped up their first day of in-person early voting in the state.
